name: BACH_0061
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1] and dual-model top-class agreement, though two nearest neighbors are InSitu.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 99%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Clear benign call; 0% risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (10% alpha, 90% coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD [F6] | Reliable quality; atypical distance, 12/12 kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign, 2/5 InSitu [F5] | Moderate neighbor agreement (60%) |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (+1.44) pushes toward invasion [F2]; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-1.22) opposes invasion [F3]; 19/20 spot check · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 4, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score (-0.73) favors duct confinement [F4]; 12/20 spot check · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 3, 7) · context · 94% neoplastic-called nuclei (100th percentile) [F7]; 77 µm² area [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk removal beat random (+0.0114; 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- **InSitu missed**: Two of five neighbors are InSitu (73% similarity, BACH_0184) with duct-confined atypia.
- **True atypia**: High neoplastic counts and nuclear shape variation (100th percentile) [F9] reflect real neoplasia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 3, 7**: Highest risk (3%) and 49–100 neoplastic-called nuclei; rule out cytologic atypia.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 11**: Highest duct-confined scores; exclude InSitu (DCIS) given neighbor BACH_0184.
